reason: The triclinic cell and likely Z=1 are strongly supported by peak positions, but exact structure recovery is not established. The comparable-score artifact supplies no score, and the trace's best declared whole-profile fit is only Rwp-like 0.108 from a highly flexible 19-site P1 refinement. A chemically favored P-1 model was discussed and charge-flipped but never instantiated and comparably refined; Li/O-swapped and other ordering possibilities were not exhaustively subjected to the final profile refinement, even though a Li/O-swapped model improved the extracted-intensity residual before qualitative rejection. The submitted models also contain severely implausible Cs-O contacts (1.96-2.05 angstrom) and questionable bond-valence chemistry. Thus the cell/average framework may be credible, but the symmetry, coordinates, occupancies, and element ordering remain materially uncertain, and a scientifically motivated alternative could improve the candidate set.
